name: Gnashing Night
look: a hunched beast of ragged living shadow with a gaping red maw of great white fangs, a teal glow in its throat, a swept-back crest of pale bone, long hooked claws and splayed jagged feet
entry: A Pokémon resembling Darkrai, described in a village elder's warning about a beast of shadow that prowled the forest on moonless nights. Its jaws were said to swallow dreams whole.
how: Wild: very rare at night in dark forests.
